title: Seoul’s housing relief depends on where you look
caption:
While high-end districts in Seoul see a price dip, the rest of the city is facing a different reality. New data shows how mortgage caps on luxury properties are actually driving up costs for middle-class neighborhoods.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul’s housing relief depends on where you look
